decisions.reason: The online customer portal is relatively far from the firm's paper-display knowledge base and, despite the firm's own R&D, the weak website presence suggests limited absorptive capacity and uncertain commercial learning, so management would be inclined to discontinue it.

This packaging display solution builds directly on the firm's established cardboard-display capabilities and its award-winning market validation gives management strong reasons to retain and further exploit it.

The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is close to the firm's core retail-display business, so its existing knowledge, production setup, and customer relationships make continued improvement and commercialization likely.

The small cardboard counter display fits the firm's narrow but deep specialization in temporary in-store paperboard displays, which makes it easy to understand customer feedback and refine the product.

The large freestanding cardboard information display is still closely related to the firm's established offer and can be supported by its in-house design, testing, assembly, and logistics capabilities, so management would likely keep it.
